        ],

});

<li>When <code>Target=extension</code>, enter the file extension, such as &quot;jpg&quot; and &quot;txt&quot;.</li>
<li>When <code>Target=filename</code>, enter the file name, such as &quot;foo&quot; in &quot;foo.jpg&quot;.</li>
<li>When <code>Target=all</code>, it indicates any site request.</li>
<li>When <code>Target=host</code>, enter the host under the current site, such as &quot;www.maxx55.com&quot;.</li>
<li>When <code>Target=url</code>, enter the partial URL path under the current site, such as &quot;/example&quot;.</li>
<li>When <code>Target=full_url</code>, enter the complete URL under the current site. It must contain the HTTP protocol, host, and path, such as &quot;https://www.maxx55.cn/example&quot;.</li>
<li>When <code>Target=client_country</code>, enter the ISO-3166 country/region code.</li>
<li>When <code>Target=query_string</code>, enter the value of the query string, such as &quot;cn&quot; and &quot;1&quot; in &quot;lang=cn&amp;version=1&quot;.</li>
<li>When <code>Target=request_header</code>, enter the HTTP request header value, such as &quot;zh-CN,zh;q=0.9&quot; in the &quot;Accept-Language:zh-CN,zh;q=0.9&quot; header.</li>
</ul></dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

## Import



teo teoFunctionRule can be imported using the zoneId#functionId#ruleId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/functionRule:FunctionRule example zone-3fkff38fyw8s#ef-m01xn26e#rule-yuvufj6h
```
